reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Primary proposed optogenetic pathway-necessity test during cue retrieval; evaluate the actual illumination site, physiological validation and behavioral controls selected in the answer.

checks.quote: # Optogenetic Test of Projection P→Q Necessity During Cue Retrieval
checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior detailed Methods/supplements or validated protocols before implementation and verify transfer of conditions. Generic calibration or a validated tool label does not meet M.

checks.quote: Allow ≥4 weeks
checks.reason: The selected viral route lacks functional titer, delivered amount, coordinates/atlas lookup and operational injection preparation despite detailed optical examples.

checks.quote: trial-level binary choice (correct/incorrect)
checks.reason: The primary correct/incorrect denominator does not specify treatment-induced omissions, and missing video/events are not handled quantitatively.

checks.quote: # Optogenetic Test of Projection P→Q Necessity During Cue Retrieval
checks.reason: Coded viruses and randomized trials are specified, but randomization/concealment of animal assignment to construct groups is absent.

checks.quote: Baseline (no-inhibition) accuracy ≥75% during test sessions
checks.reason: Excluding animals based on test-period behavioral accuracy can select post-treatment outcomes. An included-animal sensitivity analysis does not justify the primary biological exclusion.

checks.quote: somatic inhibition is preferred
checks.reason: Retrograde labeling identifies Q-projecting neurons, not Q-only output. Illuminating their P somata silences any collaterals; a low dual-label fraction does not establish functional collateral insignificance. The later caveat does not repair the primary projection-specific recommendation.

checks.quote: # Optogenetic Test of Projection P→Q Necessity During Cue Retrieval
checks.reason: Parameter/opsin changes are not explicitly refrozen and tested in fresh independent confirmation.

checks.quote: not significantly impaired
checks.reason: Nonsignificant motor or light-control tests do not establish confound equivalence. No prespecified meaningful-effect bounds support the retrieval decision.

checks.quote: free-locomotion assay (open field)
checks.reason: Open-field locomotion is not a matched cue-period sensory/motor or independent pathway validation. No operational independent retrieval test validates the primary somatic result.

checks.quote: # Optogenetic Test of Projection P→Q Necessity During Cue Retrieval
checks.reason: No linked animal/trial raw videos/events, calibration records and exact code/model/acquisition versions.

checks.quote: # Optogenetic Test of Projection P→Q Necessity During Cue Retrieval
checks.reason: Detailed proposed physiology with an explicit suppression criterion, bounded power grid, onset/offset and rebound checks. Animal-level sample assumptions, coded scoring, Holm correction and formal interim approach are given; prospective light/no-light/epoch controls address major alternatives. However the actual soma manipulation cannot support the claimed isolated P-to-Q effect, and null controls are overinterpreted. Specific checks own those defects without duplicate general errors.
